en.t: Who would want to get excited...

units.source_text: 我常常不由的想：冥冥之中好像有谁为了玩弄我，才让啰喀出现在我眼前。

en.t: I often cannot help thinking that somewhere in the dark, someone must have made Roka appear before my eyes just to toy with me.

units.source_text: 别看哲学家马咯成天在彩色玻璃灯笼下读那些古书，但他对这种事却相当了解呢。”

en.t: Philosopher Mag may spend all day reading those old books under a colored glass lantern, but he actually understands this sort of thing quite well.
